description: This is a test class for EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao, which tests various CRUD and search operations related to employee immigration records in a Human Resource Management System. The class extends a TestCase base class and includes methods to verify save, edit, retrieve, delete, and search functionalities of the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordDaoTest
